findings.issue: `SchwartzMap.norm_toBesselPotentialSpaceCLM_one_sq` (already on main, used by `inv_two_pi_sq_mul_integral_norm_lineDerivOp_sq_le` and cited by PlaneShear.lean) is the `r = 0` Schwartz case of the new `BesselPotentialSpace.norm_sq_eq_norm_inclusion_sq_add_sum_norm_lineDerivCLM_sq`, yet keeps its own 20-line Fourier/Parseval proof (lines 166-187). summary: The earlier findings are fixed, but the existing `SchwartzMap.norm_toBesselPotentialSpaceCLM_one_sq` on main is a special case of the new Plancherel identity and still has its own separate Fourier proof. The new Gaussian `H^{1,2}` computation does not reuse it either.
